items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: So I started playing bari with Maynard. And that was a childhood dream.

ctx.x: Oh on the radio was everybody, but the first introductions I had, the first album I believe was Maynard Ferguson’s “Live at Newport” in ’50. And boy I can still scat all of the tunes on that record. I mean I loved that record.
